maya: quick heads-up 1 opening a small PR to clarify the Private installer docs for air-gapped/on-prem KMS + HSM. Current example does blanket MASQUERADE which hides source IP and breaks HSM audit logs. Need a fast review.

eli: paste the exact snippets you want to add so infra can sanity-check.

maya: added concise examples to the PR: iptables (insert RETURN before MASQUERADE to exempt HSM subnet): ```sh
iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 172.31.200.0/24 -j RETURN
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -m comment --comment "egress-masq" -j MASQUERADE
``` nftables (explicit accept above masquerade): ```nft
table ip nat {
  chain postrouting {
    type nat hook postrouting priority 100;
    ip saddr 10.0.0.0/16 ip daddr 172.31.200.0/24 accept
    oifname "eth0" masquerade comment "egress-masq"
  }
}
```

tara: good. please add preflight checks (ip_forward, route to HSM IP, nft/iptables rule presence, and clock sync). HSM certs are strict on time.

maya: added preflight snippet: ```sh
# preflight
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ERROR: ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 172.31.200.10 || echo "WARN: no route to HSM"
iptables -t nat -S | grep -E "MASQUERADE|RETURN" || true
nft list ruleset | grep -E "masquerade|postrouting" || true
date -u && timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized || echo "WARN: clock unsynced"
```

eli: add a chrony snippet for sealed installs (point to local NTP appliance, do NOT enable public pools) and a short canary migration path (deploy 1 passthrough node, verify sign/verify, then cordon/drain+roll).

maya: added chrony example and a 3-step migration checklist to the PR. Also included two minimal SDK examples (Go + Python) showing TLS client certs to KMS: ```go
client, _ := redwood.NewPrivateClient(redwood.ClientOptions{
  KMSEndpoint: "https://kms.internal:8443",
  ClientCert:  "/etc/pki/client.crt",
  ClientKey:   "/etc/pki/client.key",
  CACert:      "/etc/pki/ca.crt",
})
_ = client.Healthcheck()
``` ```python
from redwood_sdk import PrivateClient
client = PrivateClient(kms_endpoint="https://kms.internal:8443", client_cert=("/etc/pki/client.crt","/etc/pki/client.key"), verify="/etc/pki/ca.crt")
client.healthcheck()
```

tara: one more thing 1 include a tiny test-hsm-netns.sh script so engineers can validate locally (bridged netns + curl with client cert). Low friction reduces support load. Also change wording "preserve src" -> "preserve source IP for HSM audit logs" for compliance.

maya: added netns test script and swapped wording per compliance. Included a compact ASCII packet-flow diagram in the PR to help orientation.
